fixes.what: Hide the "How we work +" tab while the hero is in view on desktop too: change to `(heroInView || (!isDesktop() && hideWhileScrolling))`.
fixes.why: The first screen is the one approved composition (video, logo, canopy); a boxed ghost tab at the right edge mid-hero (desktop shot 0) is the only element that breaks it, and phones already hide it there.

fixes.what: While #inquire or the footer is in view, swap the header Inquire to the ghost style (toggle a class in the same observer callback) so only "Begin the conversation" is gold-filled.
fixes.why: The system promises one gold button per screen; desktop shot 4 and phone shot 4 show two.

fixes.what: Move the sprig inside the night section (`top:clamp(24px,4vh,48px)`, keep left:-20px) so it never crosses the parchment edge; keep the seam clean.
fixes.why: In desktop shot 3 the leaf straddles the parchment/night boundary and reads as a stray sticker on the light band rather than part of the tree.

fixes.what: Give the five strips more presence: `.is-open{flex:4.5 1 0}`, strips `filter:blur(3px) brightness(.95)`, and a 2px gold bottom rule under each vertical label.
fixes.why: At 1440 the strips are ~85px of near-black blur with a gold word, so the row reads as a barcode of dark bars rather than five photographs waiting to open.

fixes.what: On phones remove the inert فارسی label from the bar and put one line in the drawer ("فارسی · coming soon"); keep the desktop label but drop the 10px size.
fixes.why: A dead language switch with a 10-12px Persian "soon" crammed under it (phone shots 0-4) is the least premium pixel in the header, on every screen.

fixes.what: On phones drop the SCROLL cue (display:none) or centre it (`left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)`).
fixes.why: In phone shot 0 "SCROLL ↓" sits flush beside the round pause button and reads as its label; the canopy already draws the eye down.
